headline: Frequent Rework of FastAPI Utils File
diagnosis: The file fastapi/utils.py is undergoing frequent rework primarily due to ongoing changes in Pydantic support and internal type management. The recurring theme in the commit messages indicates a struggle to maintain compatibility with both Pydantic v1 and v2, leading to multiple fixes and refactors.
plan: Conduct a thorough review of all recent commits to identify specific areas of instability related to Pydantic compatibility.
Create a dedicated compatibility layer or abstraction to handle differences between Pydantic v1 and v2, minimizing direct code changes in fastapi/utils.py.
Implement comprehensive unit tests targeting the create_model_field function and other critical areas to ensure stability during future changes.
Establish a clear deprecation policy for Pydantic v1 support, ensuring all team members are aware of the timeline and implications.
owner_hint: Ownership should be assigned to a single engineer to reduce bus factor.
